# Quarterly Internal Control and AML Review

This document outlines the critical tasks for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   **Internal Control Review:** Quarterly review and monitoring of internal controls are required.
*   **AML Detection Review:** Review of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection processes based on audit findings.
*   **Internal Control Updates:** Internal controls must be updated based on audit recommendations.
